turns.user_message: CI started failing this morning with 'pull access denied for myorg/myapp, repository does not exist or may require docker login'. Nothing changed in CI config. Image exists; I can pull it from my laptop. Why?
turns.se_response_summary: Five mechanisms behind 'unauthorized'/'pull access denied': (1) Creds missing/expired on the runner specifically (most likely given 'works locally'). (2) Token rotated (ECR/GAR/short-lived). (3) Wrong registry/path or IP allowlist. (4) Docker Hub anonymous rate limit (different error: 'toomanyrequests'). (5) Repository policy/RBAC change. Error wording 'repo does not exist or may require login' is specifically the 'no/bad creds' case — narrows to (1) or (2). Three checks: (a) cat ~/.docker/config.json | jq .auths; (b) curl -u USER:PASS https://<registry>/v2/...; (c) what registry?

turns.user_message: It's ECR (123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/myorg/myapp:v0.42). Yeah, looking at our CI history, this same job hit a similar failure 12 hours ago that auto-recovered on a retry. So the 12-hour token thing fits.
turns.se_response_summary: ECR tokens are 12-hour. Fix: refresh login at start of every CI job, not once at runner setup. aws ecr get-login-password | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin <account>.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. For GitHub Actions: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2 wraps this. For cluster-side (EKS/ECS), prefer IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) — kubelet/agent fetches fresh token automatically; no 12-hour pain.

What's the cluster-side equivalent that doesn't need rotating creds?

turns.user_message: The same image fails to pull in our EKS cluster too — pods stuck ImagePullBackOff. Same fix?
turns.se_response_summary: Same root cause, different mechanism in k8s. Two patterns: (A) Node IAM role (preferred, most EKS) — instance role has AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly; kubelet calls ECR with that role; no docker login involved. Validate: aws ecr get-authorization-token from the node. (B) imagePullSecrets in pod spec (manual creds) — stale after 12h. Fix by switching to (A), or set up a CronJob that refreshes the Secret every 6h. Diagnose pod-side: kubectl describe pod | grep -i 'failed\|pull'; kubectl get events.

turns.user_message: Devin sometimes hits docker pull rate limit errors when building from Docker Hub images. Different error?
turns.se_response_summary: Different fm: docker.fm.image-pull-rate-limit. Distinguish by 'toomanyrequests' keyword vs 'denied/unauthorized'. Docker Hub anonymous = ~100/6h per IP; authed = ~200; paid = unlimited. Three fixes: (1) Authenticate (even free Docker Hub doubles the limit) — Devin blueprint setup with docker login. (2) Mirror Docker Hub in private registry (ECR/GAR/Harbor) and pull FROM <mirror>/library/alpine. (3) Devin's onboard-network doc covers configuring an org-level Docker Hub mirror.
